evidence_timeline.summary: We report the classification of optical transient ZTF26abmlfan/AT 2026yxi as a tidal disruption event (TDE). The source was selected by the tdescore ML classifier (Stein+2024, doi: 10.3847/2041-8213/ad3337) as a candidate TDE, primarily due to its persistent blue colour and the lack of AGN-like host signatures. Subsequent follow-up suggests a probable featureless TDE classification. The source has recently peaked, and remains bright (mg=18.1).
